horses.incident_text: On jumping was crowded between MOTOR and INCREDIBLE MOMENT which shifted out.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped on jumping.
No report.
Jumped only fairly and then bumped with SHOTGUN due to both runners shifting ground.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  L Ferraris reported that making the Home Turn his mount became slightly awkward in its action which resulted in him looking down.
Bumped on jumping.  Trainer W K Mo confirmed that from a wide barrier the intention was to ride the horse with cover.
No report.

In the early stages lay in and away from RUBY SAILING when being ridden forward to cross NOBLE FANS.  B Avdulla stated that his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and was disappointing.  Trainer D A Hayes stated that, in his opinion, the horse was required to work hard in the early stages to cross runners to its inside and as a result was unable to finish the race off.  He added that the horse would be given a short let-up before returning to racing with the intention to ride it in a more conservative manner in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Near the 1000 Metres raced tight to the inside of VIGOR EYE which lay in and away from RUBY SAILING.  M L Yeung could offer no explanation for his mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  After the race was found to have bled from both nostrils and also to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.  Before being allowed to race again, EVERYONE’S GALLOP will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Approaching the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of VIGOR ELLEEGANT.
No report.
No report.
No report.
Jumped only fairly and then was bumped by CAPITAL LINK which shifted in.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Slow to begin. Approaching the 1100 Metres commenced to race keenly and got its head up for some distance when being steadied away from RAGING RAPIDS.  VIGOR ELLEEGANT continued to race keenly throughout the middle stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea and also found it to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.  Before being allowed to race again, VIGOR ELLEEGANT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  In the middle stages raced keenly and near the 900 Metres was steadied away from RAGING RAPIDS.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 500 Metres was bumped by LUCKY TOGETHER when that runner was taken wider.  In the Home Straight lay in under pressure.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly and then made contact with JOLTIN.
Jumped awkwardly and made contact with the left side of its starting gate.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Jumped only fairly.  In the middle stages raced keenly when being steadied to allow RED SEA to cross.  Between the 450 Metres and the 400 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of RED SEA.

Shifted out abruptly on jumping and was bumped.  When questioned Apprentice E C W Wong stated that he was requested to hold an on-pace position.  He said as his mount was dropping back in distance he rode it along in the early stages to ensure he was able to comply with his instructions.  He said when caught wide to the outside of HAROLD WIN in the early stages and when his mount was not showing sufficient pace to cross that runner, he then elected to endeavour to obtain cover behind HAROLD WIN.  He added as ANODE was racing keenly it would not respond to his efforts to restrain and obtain cover which resulted in ANODE racing very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

At declaration time, M L Yeung was declared as the rider of both JOLTIN and TACTICAL VICTORY.  It was established that M L Yeung had a firm commitment to ride JOLTIN.  As such, the Stewards permitted R Kingscote to be substituted as the rider of TACTICAL VICTORY.  For this declaration error, Jockey Yeung was fined $2,000.  Jumped only fairly and then was steadied when crowded between RED SEA and ANODE which shifted out abruptly.

Had its right hind plate refitted in the saddling stalls, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  After improving to the outside of RISING FROM ASHES near the 500 Metres was then hampered when taken wider by RISING FROM ASHES (H T Mo) which shifted out whilst not clear, resulting in LUCKY TOGETHER making contact with MICKLEY.  H T Mo was advised to exercise more care.
No report.

Approaching the 600 Metres was eased when racing tight to the inside of TACTICAL VICTORY.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, RISING FROM ASHES will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Near the 900 Metres AUDACIOUS PURSUIT, which continued to race keenly, was steadied to avoid FOREVER GLORIOUS, resulting in AUDACIOUS PURSUIT shifting out and making heavy contact with SHARPEN BRIGHT.  When B Avdulla, rider of SHARPEN BRIGHT, then rode to hold his position, AUDACIOUS PURSUIT and SHARPEN BRIGHT made contact for some distance thereafter when they contested the position to the outside of FOREVER GLORIOUS.  After considering the incident the Stewards were satisfied that Apprentice E C W Wong had not intentionally attempted to shift to the outside of FOREVER GLORIOUS and the contact was due to the racing manners of AUDACIOUS PURSUIT.  Near the 500 Metres shifted out and made contact with CHARITY TOGETHER.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.  Leaving the 150 Metres was steadied and shifted to the inside of AUDACIOUS PURSUIT when disappointed for clear running between CHARITY TOGETHER and AUDACIOUS PURSUIT.

Near the 500 Meters was contacted by AUDACIOUS PURSUIT (Apprentice E C W Wong) when that horse shifted to the outside of SHARPEN BRIGHT to improve.  CHARITY TOGETHER was further hampered when taken wider approaching the 500 Metres when AUDACIOUS PURSUIT continued to shift out.  Apprentice Wong was reprimanded.  L Ferraris dropped his right rein near the 50 Metres.
No report.
Shifted out on jumping and was bumped.

Approaching the 350 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between SERANGOON and FOREVER GLORIOUS.  YIU CHEUNG VICTORY then had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching the 300 Metres when being shifted to the outside of FOREVER GLORIOUS.  A Badel stated that his instructions were to settle the horse where comfortable.  He said after being hampered on jumping when ACE shifted out his mount settled further back in the field than what he had anticipated.  Trainer C H Yip confirmed the instructions issued and said that as the horse raced keenly at its last start with visors on he removed visors from the horse’s gear and had instructed Jockey Badel not to make use of the horse in the early stages so that it would settle better.
No report.
H Bowman stated that his mount was pressured in the lead and was unable to finish the race off.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
L Hewitson stated that his mount jumped well from the outside barrier and as a result settled in a more forward position than intended.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
C Y Ho reported that his mount did not appreciate the "Good to Firm” track conditions.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Between the 950 Metres and the 850 Metres made contact with AUDACIOUS PURSUIT on a number of occasions as SHARPEN BRIGHT was ridden to hold its position to prevent AUDACIOUS PURSUIT from shifting out.  When giving ground near the 400 Metres was eased when crowded between AUDACIOUS PURSUIT and FOREVER GLORIOUS which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  As a result a short distance K C Leung was required to reposition his left foot in the stirrup iron.  Near the 1500 Metres was steadied to avoid AUDACIOUS PURSUIT which shifted out slightly.  K C Leung reported that his mount hung in, particularly in the Home Straight and, in his opinion, did not appreciate the "Good to Firm” track conditions.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horse’s trachea.
Near the 800 Metres was steadied when positioned close to the heels of TURIN MASCOT.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Near the 800 Metres was taken wider by SKY VINO and then was obliged to race very wide and without cover thereafter.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Blundered on jumping, became unbalanced, shifted out and made contact with DRAGON AIR FORCE.  Bumped near the 400 Metres.
Shifted in on jumping and bumped DRAGON AIR FORCE.
Near the 400 Metres made contact with ROMANTIC THOR when disappointed for clear running to the outside of CHILL KAKA.  Lay out under pressure over the final 100 Metres.
Jumped only fairly.
No report.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
L Hewitson was warned for using his whip forward of the saddle in a forehand manner on one occasion near the 350 Metres.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

R Kingscote reported that he had to make some use of the horse in the early stages to race outside the lead.  He said with the early and middle stages of the event being run inside of standard time CHILL KAKA was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 900 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid SKY VINO.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

M F Poon stated that his mount failed to travel throughout the race and, in his opinion, was not suited by racing on the All Weather surface.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

L Ferraris stated that with blinkers being reapplied today WINFIELD raced too keenly in the lead and as a result set a faster pace than he would have liked.  He added as a result WINFIELD weakened in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of WINFIELD, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, WINFIELD will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  <16/2/2026 Additional Veterinary Report> WINFIELD, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  WINFIELD was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer M Newnham yesterday morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  As previously advised, WINFIELD will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
Slow to begin.  Making the Home Turn raced ungenerously when being shifted out to secure clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly, shifted in and made contact with ARIEL.  Lay in in the Home Straight and proved difficult to ride out.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  C Y Ho reported that the intention was to hold a more forward position but after shifting out on jumping and making contact with SUPERB GUY his mount did not show sufficient pace to go forward.
No report.
No report.
No report.
Slow to begin. M F Poon was severely reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides approaching the 150 Metres.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 300 Metres lay in and away from SWAGGER BRO and was steadied to avoid CALIFORNIA STAR.  Near the 100 Metres was again steadied to avoid BULL ATTITUDE (A Badel) which shifted to the outside of CALIFORNIA STAR to improve.  A Badel was advised to exercise more care.

Jumped only fairly and then was hampered when bumped by FIREFOOT which shifted out.  M Chadwick reported that from a wide barrier he was instructed to obtain cover on the horse.  Trainer K W Lui confirmed the instructions issued.
Bumped on jumping.  Raced wide and without cover until near the 900 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A Atzeni stated that his mount led the event as expected.  He said when he asked for an effort in the Home Straight the horse failed to respond to his riding and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SIGHT DREAMER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Slow to begin.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Between the 450 Metres and the 400 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of SKY TRUST.  C Y Ho reported that his mount settled further back than he had intended as it did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to hold a more forward position.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Bumped after the 200 Metres.

Approaching the 50 Metres was shifted to the inside of GUSTOSISIMO to obtain clear running and over the concluding stages raced tight between GUSTOSISIMO and MAGIC CONTROL and as a result made contact with MAGIC CONTROL.

Between the 450 Metres and the 250 Metres was held up for clear running behind LADY’S CHOICE.  Approaching the 200 Metres improved into a narrow run between LADY’S CHOICE and WUNDERBAR and as a result made contact with WUNDERBAR for some distance thereafter.  Bumped over the concluding stages.
Jumped only fairly.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

For some distance near the 200 Metres made contact with MAGIC CONTROL when that runner shifted out to improve.  After the 200 Metres raced tight between GUSTOSISIMO and MAGIC CONTROL and as a result made contact with GUSTOSISIMO.  H Bowman could offer no excuse for the horse’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.
No report.

Jumped only fairly and then was bumped by GUSTOSISIMO which shifted out.  Near the 800 Metres SWIFT ASCEND (A Badel) shifted in, resulting in INVINCIBLE SHIELD being taken in towards MUGEN which resulted in MUGEN racing tight to the inside of INVINCIBLE SHIELD.  A short distance later SWIFT ASCEND improved to the inside of ALL OUT FOR SIX (Y L Chung) when that runner shifted out slightly and gave ground.  When ALL OUT FOR SIX then shifted back in slightly SWIFT ASCEND was taken in onto INVINCIBLE SHIELD which resulted in MUGEN being checked when crowded onto the running rail.  After considering the incident both A Badel and Y L Chung were advised to exercise more care and to ensure they leave sufficient racing room for runners to their inside.  When commencing to finish the race off well near the 100 Metres could not be ridden out to the finish when held up for clear running between LADY’S CHOICE and WUNDERBAR, both of which shifted ground.

L Ferraris stated that when placed under pressure in the Home Straight his mount failed to respond to his riding and he was concerned there may be something amiss with it.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY WITH YOU will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Was examined by the Veterinary Officer on arrival at the Start, was found to be lame in its right front leg and was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, PATCH OF STARS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again

horses.incident_text: Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.
Near the 400 Metres was shifted to the outside of THE ALL ROUNDER to obtain clear running and made contact with GENIUS BABY.
No report.
Slow to begin.

Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres was held up for clear running.  After obtaining clear running after the 350 Metres again had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching the 200 Metres when held up behind NYX GLUCK.

Jumped awkwardly.  Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Z Purton stated that the horse may not have run out a strong 1400 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea and also found the horse to have a respiratory condition which requires further assessment.  Before being allowed to race again, SOLID CAR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped near the 400 Metres.  K Teetan reported that his mount may not have run out the 1400 Metres of today’s race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

C Y Ho reported that his mount travelled satisfactorily behind midfield in the early stages.  He said making the turn after the 900 Metres DECISION LINK came under pressure and as a result drifted back in the field.  He added in the Home Straight DECISION LINK finished the race off only fairly.

Jumped only fairly.   J Orman advised that he had been instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages to attempt to have the horse finish its race off as it had been racing in a disappointing manner at its previous race starts.  He said shortly after the start he endeavoured to steady his mount to obtain a position with cover.  He added when racing tight to the inside of GENIUS BABY (K Teetan), STARRY SHOW got its head up when he was obliged to ease his mount.  K Teetan was advised to exercise more care.  Again near the 1200 Metres got its head up and refused to settle when racing behind ALWAYS FLUKE.

Noted to have blood in the mouth on arrival at the Start, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  When questioned Y L Chung stated that the instructions were to settle the horse back in the field from its wide barrier and to ensure that he improved to the outside in the Home Straight as MULTISUPERSTAR had been held up at its first race start when positioned to the inside.  He said after following STARRY SHOW throughout the event he elected to shift to that runner’s outside to comply with those instructions, however, when STARRY SHOW shifted out he was held up for clear running behind that horse near the 400 Metres.  He added having regard to his instructions he persisted for a run to the outside of STARRY SHOW and after being held up between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres he endeavoured to improve between STARRY SHOW and THE ALL ROUNDER, however, MULTISUPERSTAR lay out and was unable to proceed into that run.  He said as a result MULTISUPERSTAR then had difficulty obtaining clear running until near the 100 Metres when he shifted to the inside of STARRY SHOW.  When questioned as to whether there was an opportunity to shift to the inside of STARRY SHOW near the 400 Metres, Y L Cheung stated that as his instructions were to come to the outside he had not observed this run to be available and therefore did not contemplate taking that position.  After considering his explanation the Stewards advised Jockey Chung that whilst he believed his instructions were to come to the outside he should, wherever possible, ensure that he obtains the first run that becomes available, particularly in circumstances when he is experiencing difficulty in obtaining clear running.
Raced keenly in the middle stages.

Apprentice E C W Wong reported that the intention was to hold a midfield position.  He said when his mount was caught wide in the early stages he elected to go forward but was unable to cross runners to his inside which resulted in LEATHER GOODS racing wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  He added making the Home Turn LEATHER GOODS dipped its head on a number of occasions and when he was concerned there was something amiss with it he eased it down in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of LEATHER GOODS was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, LEATHER GOODS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

When questioned B Avdulla stated that his intention was to endeavour to find a position towards the grandstand rail.  He said in the early stages he shifted behind PI LEGEND with a view to continuing to shift to that runner’s outside.  He added that when SPARKLING FELLOW improved to his outside he was unable to continue to shift out and as a result he was positioned behind PI LEGEND.  He said SIGHT HERMOSO did not travel well during the early and middle stages of the event and when he observed the favourite CITY GOLD BANNER improve to his inside near the 350 Metres he elected to shift to the inside of PI LEGEND where he placed his mount under pressure.  He further stated that SIGHT HERMOSO lay in over the concluding stages and as a result he was required to shift his weight in the saddle to prevent it from shifting ground further.
No report.
Bumped on jumping. L Ferraris was severely reprimanded in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion after the 200 Metres.
Jumped only fairly.

Z Purton stated that his mount was fractious whilst proceeding to the starting gates.  He said when the start was effected CITY GOLD BANNER was slow to begin and as a result settled back in the field. He added in the Home Straight his mount responded only fairly when placed under pressure.  Trainer J Richards stated that, in his opinion, the horse was disadvantaged by racing towards the middle of the track but was satisfied with its effort.  He added he would now look to step the horse up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Approaching the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving into a narrow run between SPARKLING FELLOW and CENTRAL BANK.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.  When placed under pressure in the Home Straight lay in and proved difficult to ride.
No report.
Bumped on jumping.  Hung out in the Home Straight.
Jumped only fairly.
Near the 1300 Metres was checked to avoid LUCKY CANDY when that runner gave ground quickly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
L Hewitson stated that when his mount jumped well it was able to go forward and lead the event, particularly with the early stages being run outside of standard time.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Near the 500 Metres improved into a narrow run between LEGEND WINNER and NATURAL NUMBERS and as a result made contact with NATURAL NUMBERS.  Between the 450 Metres and the 250 Metres was badly held up for clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped near the 500 Metres.
Jumped only fairly and then was bumped shortly after the start.

Jumped only fairly, shifted out and bumped SHANWAH.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  After obtaining clear running leaving the 300 Metres ENTHUSIUM was again held up for clear running when disappointed for a run between CHILL EASY and NATURAL NUMBERS and as a result was shifted to the inside of NATURAL NUMBERS near the 100 Metres to secure clear running.

Approaching the 1300 Metres was steadied when crowded by NATURAL NUMBERS (M F Poon) when that runner shifted out after being crossed by WITHOUT COMPARE.  M F Poon was advised to exercise more care.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Leaving the 1500 Metres was hampered when taken wider by LUCKY CANDY which shifted out abruptly.  K Teetan reported that his mount raced greenly throughout the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

H Bowman explained that when positioned to the outside of CHILL EASY approaching the 1300 Metres he was commencing to steady his mount to obtain cover behind CHILL EASY.  He said when CHILL EASY was taken out GLITTERING LEGEND was hampered when crowded between ENDUED and CHILL EASY.

On jumping struck the heels of A TIME FOR US and blundered badly when A TIME FOR US shifted in abruptly despite the efforts of its rider Y L Chung.  Near the 1300 Metres was steadied to avoid LUCKY CANDY when that runner shifted in.
No report.

Shifted in abruptly on jumping, was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.  Y L Chung reported that his mount hung in when placed under pressure in the Home Straight and gave ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with MIGHTY MASTS.  When questioned K C Leung stated that with the hood being removed for today’s race he had been requested to ride the horse quietly in the early stages to attempt to have it settle.  He said after being positioned behind MIGHTY MASTS in the early stages he endeavoured to restrain his mount but when the pace was being run outside of standard time in the early stages, LUCKY CANDY commenced to race fiercely, got its head up and as a result shifted out when being checked.  He added LUCKY CANDY continued to race fiercely throughout the early stages and refused to settle.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The racing manners of LUCKY CANDY were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY CANDY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial.

Withdrawn on 13.2.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (irregular heart rhythm) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter STORMY GROVE.  Before being allowed to race again, CHINA WIN will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
